project_title: Pump.fun x Twitch AI Live Token Launchpad

design_direction.vibe: Pump.fun x Twitch x futuristic AI laboratory. Dark, highly polished, technical, cinematic, premium, minimal, character-first.
design_direction.backgrounds: Deep charcoal (#0B0D10) and jet black (#050608) with high-density subtle grid overlays and micro-borders.
design_direction.accent_strategy: Restrained neon accents: Cyber Cyan (#00F0FF) for active state/live, Crimson Red (#FF2E51) for dump/sell, Emerald Green (#00E699) for buy/pump, Amber Gold (#FFB800) for ATH/milestone. No excessive multi-color gradients or standard SaaS rainbow glow.
design_direction.typography: Barlow / Space Grotesk / JetBrains Mono hybrid aesthetic. Headings are aggressive, uppercase, tracked-tight. Technical readouts, tickers, and logs use crisp tabular monospace.

hierarchy.hero_title: text-4xl md:text-6xl font-black uppercase tracking-tight leading-none
hierarchy.section_title: text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold uppercase tracking-tight text-white
hierarchy.caption: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-400

header.style: Fixed z-50 top-0 w-full h-16 backdrop-blur-md bg-black/80 border-b border-[#1E2430] px-4 md:px-8 flex items-center justify-between
header.logo: Bold AI Laboratory brand mark with live pulsating badge

page_hero.headline: EVERY TOKEN IS ALIVE.
page_hero.subheadline: Launch a token. Give it a body, voice and mind.
page_hero.livestream_cards: Grid layout (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6). Each card features thumbnail, LIVE pulsing indicator, token name, $TICKER, Market Cap, 24h % change, and scrolling live subtitle preview.

page_create.warning: Immutable Metadata Warning box with terminal yellow alert styling

page_token.desktop_layout: Left 65% cinematic 3D character stage with ● AI LIVE badge, character name, $TICKER, mood subtitle, status indicator (LISTENING / THINKING / SPEAKING), and ENTER LIVE / UNMUTE AI button. Right 35% live market parameters (Market Cap, Price, 24h Volume, ATH), candlestick / price chart, live trade stream feed, and AI memory highlights.
page_token.mobile_layout: Character stage rendered first at 50vh height, followed by stacked trade feed, chart, and stats tabs.

features: Category filters (Top Market Cap, Live Now, ATH Breakers, Newest)
Simulation triggers: Small Buy, Whale Buy, Small Sell, Whale Sell, Buy Streak, Sell Streak, 20% Rally, 20% Dump, New ATH +100K Milestone, Recovery, Quiet
Realtime Dialogue Log, AI Long-Term Memory State, Emotion Matrix

buttons.primary: bg-[#00F0FF] hover:bg-[#33F3FF] text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-wider px-6 py-3 rounded-none shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,240,255,0.3)] transition-all flex items-center gap-2
buttons.secondary: bg-[#161B22] border border-[#1E2430] hover:border-[#00F0FF]/50 text-slate-200 font-medium px-4 py-2.5 rounded-none transition-all
buttons.danger: bg-[#FF2E51]/10 border border-[#FF2E51]/40 text-[#FF2E51] hover:bg-[#FF2E51]/20 font-bold px-4 py-2

cards.live_token: relative bg-[#0D0F12] border border-[#1E2430] hover:border-[#00F0FF]/40 transition-all p-4 group overflow-hidden shadow-lg
cards.character_stage: relative bg-gradient-to-b from-[#0B0D12] to-[#050608] border border-[#1E2430] h-[550px] w-full flex flex-col justify-between p-6 overflow-hidden

badges.live: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-mono font-bold bg-[#FF2E51]/15 border border-[#FF2E51]/40 text-[#FF2E51] rounded-none animate-pulse
badges.status: px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-mono border bg-[#00F0FF]/10 border-[#00F0FF]/30 text-[#00F0FF]

3d_and_audio.stage_rendering: Three.js / React Three Fiber / Canvas fallback with 3D VRM character model, orbital lighting, floating particle field, and audio lip-sync spectrum analyzer.
3d_and_audio.tts_engine: Browser Kokoro / Web Speech API / Web Audio API synthesizers with interactive audio visualizer waveform bars.

test_attributes.rule: All buttons, inputs, tabs, cards, and key stats MUST include explicit data-testid attributes in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the exact dark cyber-laboratory design language defined above.
Ensure all 5 required routes are fully implemented and functional: /, /create, /token/:mint, /explore, /dev/character-lab.
Ensure character stage on /token/:mint is prominent (desktop 65% width) with interactive sound/unmute toggle and real-time trade event reaction simulations.
Use data-testid on every interactive element for seamless testing.
Do NOT use bright childish colors or generic SaaS rounded cards. Maintain sharp edges, technical mono typography, and high contrast stats.
